sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: No supplied candidate is semantically verified as the canonical cross-owner material-to-approval/evidence relationship; the materialApprovalStatus candidate is identified only as a normalized status property and the remaining candidates are a class, boolean status, controlled value, or ship class.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Reject: the shape imposes ship-level presence of one exposedMachineryOrFoundationMaterial and one approval bundle, but the requirement is universal over every applicable exposed machinery or foundation material. It does not encode a per-material approval relationship or ensure that each material has its own approved status, authority, standard, and polarServiceTemperature basis.
